story_theme: The Friday Inertia: Mochi embodies the feeling of a week's momentum that won't stop even after the work ends.
storyboard_description: 1. A street-level shot at night after rain. Mochi is sitting alone on the curb outside an office building entrance, its back to the camera, looking across the wet street. The building behind is still lit up with cold white office light. Across the street, a small convenience store glows with warm yellow-orange light. The wet pavement reflects both. Mochi is small, still, between the two worlds. 2. A close-up shot looking down at a smartphone lying on a rumpled bed duvet. The phone screen shows a messaging app with all group chats quiet, last messages from hours ago, no new notifications. A warm bedside lamp just off-frame casts a soft orange-yellow glow on the duvet fabric around the phone. The room is dim and lived-in. In the faint dark reflection at the top of the phone screen, Mochi is a tiny shape looking down at it. 3. A wide shot of an ordinary living room late at night. A couch with an indented cushion. The TV across the room is on but showing something soft and low-key, casting a gentle shifting glow. An unfinished takeout container and a half-drunk cup sit on the coffee table. Mochi is settled on the couch cushion, small, facing the TV, quiet. The room is dim but not dark. Just an ordinary Friday night. Nothing has to happen.

panels.text:
周五了。
怎么还不像周五。

群聊安静了。
大脑还没停。

什么都不做，
也是今晚可以有的样子。

caption:
**周五最累的瞬间，不是加班。**

是走出楼的那一刻。

一周的群聊、对接、回复、收到，突然全部停了。你以为会松一口气，结果只是站在原地，不太知道接下来该干什么。大脑还在转，只是没有方向了。

这不是懒，这是一整周高速运转之后，那个“不工作的自己”还没跟上来。你坐在沙发上刷着没营养的短视频，或者对着空气发呆，这些都不是在虚度。这只是身体在缓慢地降落。

今晚，准许自己先停在这里。不用急着去开启什么充实的周末，也不用因为“什么都没做”而感到负疚。哪怕只是感受此刻静止的空气，也很好。

早点睡吧，这一周你辛苦了。
